payout_value_note: $75 per qualifying referral; up to 10 referrals ($750)
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($75-$75 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Member gets a unique referral code via email, branch, or phone and shares it. Friend enters the code on the final page of the online application (or provides it to a banker), opens membership and a personal checking account, completes 10 debit purchases and one direct deposit within 60 days.
catches: Offer available to existing OneAZ Credit Union members 18 and over in good standing, and new consumers who have not had an account with OneAZ within the past 12 months. Referring member and friend must both be 18+. Bonus cannot be combined with any other promotions. Referred member may only receive one account opening bonus payment per year. Existing members are eligible for multiple Refer-a-Friend bonuses. If the checking account is closed within 6 months, the bonus is deducted at closing. OneAZ may change or discontinue the program at any time without prior notification.

eligibility: Friend: new consumer with no OneAZ account in the past 12 months, uses the promo code at account opening, establishes membership and opens a personal checking account, completes 10 qualifying debit card purchases within the first 60 days, and completes one payroll/income electronic direct deposit within the first 60 days; checking must remain open 6 months or the bonus is deducted
timing: Deposited into the referrer's Share Savings Account within 15 days of the new member following the required steps.
